high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage featuring an article about the book "The Sorrows of Young Werther" by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe. The text is presented in a clean, readable font against a white background. The article discusses how the book, first published in 1774, became a cultural phenomenon that spread across Europe with unprecedented force, influencing fashion, behavior, and inspiring imitative works. It notes that while the book was once widely read, it is now often heard of more than read outside of classrooms or specialist reading circles.
